result.summary: Implemented docs/agents/design/REQ-028.md exactly as designed -- /checkin [query] now renders the manual check-in door list (extending REQ-018's authorization-only stub), with a per-attendee toggle callback and a page-turn callback. No schema change (confirmed by design §0 and independently re-confirmed here: `npx drizzle-kit migrate` against a freshly-reset scratch Postgres produced zero new migration files -- checked_in_by/check_in_method/chk_registrations_checked_in_only_if_admitted already existed from REQ-011). 1. apps/bot/src/domain/registration.ts: added CheckinListItem + listAdmittedRegistrantsForCheckin(db, eventId, lang) per design §2.1 -- one SELECT (registrations LEFT JOIN profiles, INNER JOIN users), WHERE admission='admitted' only, selecting registrations.id/userId/checkedInAt, profiles.firstName/lastName/company, users.tgUsername -- profiles.phone/profiles.email are structurally absent from the select clause (AC3). ORDER BY asc(lastName), asc(firstName), asc(id) -- Postgres's own ASC-NULLS-LAST default gives the design's 'nulls last' rule for free. Added a private deriveCheckinDisplayName implementing §2.1's exact 5-row fallback table. Added `lang: BotLang` as a parameter beyond the design's bare signature -- a plumbing addition (not a business rule) needed because the final fallback row returns the locale-specific checkin.noNameFallback catalog string, and CheckinListItem.displayName is specified as an already-finalized string, not raw fields. Added countCheckedIn(db, eventId) per §2.2 -- one fresh SELECT counting checked_in_at IS NOT NULL rows, no column/cache, never touches events. Added CheckinToggleDecisionInput/CheckinToggleOutcome/decideCheckinToggleOutcome per §3.1 -- pure, first-match-wins, exact 4-step table. Added toggleCheckIn(db, registrationId, staffUserId, at) per §3.2 -- db.transaction, SELECT...FOR UPDATE (fresh, locked, inside the transaction, never reusing any caller-supplied admission value), decide, and on 'check-in'/'undo' a conditional UPDATE + exactly one writeAuditLog call in the same transaction ('registration.checkin' / 'registration.checkin_undo'); the 'not-found'/'refused-not-admitted' branches write nothing and return unchanged (AC1's refusal path). 2. apps/bot/src/handlers/checkin.ts: rewrote makeCheckInHandler -- steps 1-6 (tgId/lang/parse/getEventById/endsAt-check/requireEventStaffForEvent) are byte-identical to REQ-018's stub; step 7 now calls a new buildCheckinView composition (fetch-once, filter/derive in memory per §2.1's own stated discipline) and replies with the rendered list. Added parseCheckinCommandArgs -- first-token-plus-remainder split (not first-two-tokens), since a search query may contain spaces. Added renderCheckinListMessage(eventTitle, eventId, items, checkedInCount, totalAdmitted, page, truncatedCount, lang) per §4.4 -- header line, one keyboard row per attendee (glyph + displayName [+ company]), a pagination row only for the unfiltered view (a non-interactive page-position button using a fixed, never-registered 'checkin:page:noop' callback_data per §4.4's own 'no precedent, new idiom' note), a truncation note for search overflow, and the search-hint footer on every render. Added makeCheckinToggleCallbackHandler per §4.2: re-derives eventId from the tapped registrationId via the existing getEventIdForRegistration (a separate, unlocked, read-only call from §3.2's own locked read), re-runs requireEventStaffForEvent (S2 defense in depth, §3.3), resolves the acting user's id via resolveActingUser (requireEventStaffForEvent's own return shape carries no `user` field, unlike a literal reading of the design's authResult.user.id reference at §4.2 step 4 -- a real design/reused-function-shape mismatch, resolved by calling the already-exported resolveActingUser a second time rather than inventing a new field on the reused authorization function; flagged below as a MINOR issue), then calls toggleCheckIn. On a refused outcome: answerCallbackQuery with an alert (checkin.refusedNotAdmitted), NO message edit (design §4.2 step 5 -- the stale row's button is deliberately left as-is). On check-in/undo: edits the message in place -- replaces only the header line (recomputed via a fresh countCheckedIn + the existing countAdmittedRegistrations from domain/event.ts) and only the one button whose callback_data matches the tapped registrationId (glyph swapped, rest of the label preserved from the button's own current text), leaving every other row/page-control untouched (§1.5). Added makeCheckinPageCallbackHandler per §4.3 -- re-runs the same authorization gate on every page turn, then re-renders the unfiltered list at the requested page via buildCheckinView + editMessageText. Added CHECKIN_TOGGLE_PATTERN/CHECKIN_PAGE_PATTERN, PAGE_SIZE=10, SEARCH_RESULT_LIMIT=20 (BACKEND-DEV's choice per design §1.4, comfortably covering AC6's >=10-attendee scenario). 3. apps/bot/src/i18n/{types.ts,en.ts,ru.ts}: replaced checkin.authorizedStub (REQ-018's stub acknowledgment, now dead -- no caller) with the 9 new keys design §5 specifies (listHeader, listEmpty, searchNoMatches, searchHint, searchTruncatedNote, checkedInGlyph, notCheckedInGlyph, pageIndicator, refusedNotAdmitted, noNameFallback -- 10 total including the renamed set). usageNoId/notFound/notAuthorized kept unchanged and reused for both the /checkin gate and every toggle/page callback's re-authorization refusal, per design. Placeholder/minimal functional copy per decisions/0002 (CONTENT-BA owns final wording). 4. apps/bot/src/index.ts: registered the two new callback handlers -- bot.callbackQuery(CHECKIN_TOGGLE_PATTERN, makeCheckinToggleCallbackHandler(db)) and bot.callbackQuery(CHECKIN_PAGE_PATTERN, makeCheckinPageCallbackHandler(db)) -- alongside the unchanged bot.command('checkin', makeCheckInHandler(db)) registration. All 6 ACs verified with real output against a live scratch Postgres (apps/bot/docker-compose.yml, port 55432, freshly migrated -- zero new migration files, confirming the design's 'no schema change' claim). New test file apps/bot/src/handlers/checkin.db.test.ts, 6 describe blocks (one per AC), real bot.handleUpdate() dispatch throughout (command + callback_query updates), following event.dispatch.test.ts's/reminder24h.test.ts's established fake-bot-api-capture pattern. AC1 is a GENUINE stale-render-then-write-time-change interleaving, not a pre-set-then-render shortcut: (a) /checkin is dispatched and the real sendMessage reply's reply_markup/text captured -- this IS the stale render; (b) a raw `pool.query("UPDATE registrations SET admission = 'withdrawn' ...")` changes the row directly in the DB, entirely outside the bot, strictly AFTER the render; (c) the STALE captured callback_data (unmodified) is then dispatched as a real callback_query update against the ORIGINAL captured message object -- confirming no write occurred, an alert-shown refusal was returned, no editMessageText call was made, and no audit_log row was written for that registration. Commands run from the REPO ROOT: `npm run build` -> exit 0 (apps/web Next.js build + apps/bot tsc, both clean). `npm run lint` -> exit 0, apps/bot 0 problems, apps/web 2 pre-existing unrelated warnings only (same 2 as REQ-027's own recorded baseline, unrelated to this diff -- git diff --name-only main...HEAD touches only apps/bot/**). `TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://bot:bot@localhost:55432/bot npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism` (repo root, no path filter) -> 26 files / 272 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. `git status --porcelain` before writing this handoff confirms exactly the 6 modified files plus the 1 new test file listed in artifacts_out -- no stray file, apps/web untouched, no messages/** touched.

commands: cd apps/bot && docker compose up -d -> bot-postgres-1 already running; DATABASE_URL=postgres://bot:bot@localhost:55432/bot npx drizzle-kit migrate -> migrations applied successfully, zero new migration files generated (confirms design's 'no schema change' claim)
npm run build (repo root) -> exit 0, apps/web Next.js build clean, apps/bot tsc clean
npm run lint (repo root) -> exit 0, apps/bot 0 problems, apps/web 2 pre-existing unrelated -element warnings only
TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://bot:bot@localhost:55432/bot npx vitest run apps/bot/src/handlers/checkin.db.test.ts --no-file-parallelism -> 1 file / 6 tests passed
TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://bot:bot@localhost:55432/bot npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism (repo root, full suite) -> 26 files / 272 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped

AC1 (checkin.db.test.ts 'REQ-028 AC1'): render list via real /checkin dispatch (captures the toggle button's exact callback_data, i.e. only 'checkin:toggle:<registrationId>', and the message's own reply_markup/text) -> raw SQL UPDATE registrations SET admission='withdrawn' for that registration, entirely outside the bot -> dispatch the STALE captured callback_data against the STALE captured message via a real callback_query update -> DB row confirmed unchanged (checked_in_at/checked_in_by/check_in_method all still null, admission still 'withdrawn'), answerCallbackQuery captured with show_alert=true and text=catalog.checkin.refusedNotAdmitted, zero editMessageText calls, zero new audit_log rows with action registration.checkin/registration.checkin_undo for that registration

AC2 (checkin.db.test.ts 'REQ-028 AC2'): real /checkin dispatch then a real toggle callback dispatch -> checked_in_at set (non-null), checked_in_by=the staff user's id, check_in_method='manual', exactly 1 audit_log row action='registration.checkin' and 0 action='registration.checkin_undo'; a SECOND real toggle dispatch on the same registrationId -> checked_in_at cleared to null, checked_in_by/check_in_method left unchanged from the check-in write, exactly 1 audit_log row action='registration.checkin' (unchanged) and exactly 1 action='registration.checkin_undo' (newly written)

AC3 (checkin.db.test.ts 'REQ-028 AC3'): one admitted registrant seeded with a real phone (+77011234567) and email (attendee-secret@example.com) on their profile row -> real /checkin dispatch -> the captured sendMessage text AND every button's own text checked for literal substring containment of both raw values -> neither string appears anywhere in either

AC4 (checkin.db.test.ts 'REQ-028 AC4'): 2 admitted registrants, initial /checkin render shows '0 / 2' via the header string -> a raw SQL UPDATE sets checked_in_at directly on one registration's row, entirely outside the bot/toggle path -> a SECOND, independent /checkin dispatch shows '1 / 2' -- proving the counter is a fresh read, not a cached/stored value; the events row (full column set) is byte-identical before vs. after the whole sequence via toEqual

AC5 (checkin.db.test.ts 'REQ-028 AC5'): capacity-1 event with 1 admitted + 1 waitlisted (via the real registerForEvent capacity path) + 1 withdrawn (direct insert with admission='withdrawn') registrant, the latter two given distinctively-named profiles ('Hidden Waitlisted'/'Hidden Withdrawn') -> real /checkin dispatch -> the admitted attendee's name appears in a button; neither 'Waitlisted' nor 'Withdrawn' name-fragment appears anywhere in the rendered text or any button text

AC6 (checkin.db.test.ts 'REQ-028 AC6'): 10 admitted attendees sharing the last name 'Common' plus 1 uniquely-named attendee ('Zharkyn Unique') -> real /checkin <event_id> Zharkyn dispatch -> exactly 1 toggle button rendered, containing both 'Zharkyn' and 'Unique'; the rendered text contains no 'Guest' fragment (confirming the other 10 were excluded, not merely unlisted by coincidence) and no pagination controls (search view is unpaginated per design §1.4)

ac_results.AC1: PASS -- genuine stale-render-then-write-time-change interleaving: no write, alert-shown refusal, zero audit rows, zero message edits
ac_results.AC2: PASS -- first tap sets checked_in_at/checked_in_by/check_in_method + exactly 1 checkin audit row; second tap clears checked_in_at only + exactly 1 checkin_undo audit row
ac_results.AC3: PASS -- neither the seeded phone nor email appears anywhere in the rendered text or any button label
ac_results.AC4: PASS -- counter reflects a check-in set directly in the DB on the very next independent render; events table byte-identical before/after
ac_results.AC5: PASS -- only the admitted attendee's name appears; waitlisted/withdrawn attendees' names appear nowhere in text or buttons
ac_results.AC6: PASS -- a 10-attendee list plus one uniquely-named attendee narrows to exactly 1 button on a name-fragment search

issues.title: design/REQ-028.md §4.2 step 4 references authResult.user.id, but requireEventStaffForEvent's actual return type (CheckInAuthorizationResult, unchanged from REQ-018) carries no `user` field on its ok:true branch
issues.description: The design states the toggle callback should call toggleCheckIn(db, registrationId, authResult.user.id, ...), but eventStaffAuthorization.ts's requireEventStaffForEvent -- which the design itself lists as 'reused unchanged' -- returns only { ok: true } | { ok: false, reason }, no user object. Resolved here by calling the already-exported resolveActingUser(db, tgId) a second time to obtain the staff user's id, rather than inventing a new field on the reused authorization function (which would be an unreviewed change to a security-relevant, already-passed-gate module) or inventing an actorUserId sourcing rule not stated anywhere else. This is a plumbing-level design/implementation mismatch, not a business-rule gap -- flagging per core-directives.md's 'never resolve a conflict silently' rule rather than fixing it invisibly.
